title: Portable Tool Schema Audit: fuzzy shape detection, auto-fixes, and UI hints
creator: Ethan Zhang
description: Audit and implement a portable schema validation layer for tool/function calling. Deliver a 'shape-auditor' that uses fuzzy matching to detect intended parameter shapes across variants of JSON schema, surface human-readable repair suggestions in error messages, and provide a thin compatibility adapter for legacy SDKs. Scope includes authoring a compact schema annotation format, runtime streaming-parse hooks for early validation in streaming responses, a mapping from low-level validator errors to UI-friendly messages, and migration scripts for existing tool manifests.
acceptance_criteria: Shape-auditor can detect and classify 95% of common variant shape mismatches in our test corpus
Validator returns structured error codes and humanized messages for all failure classes
Legacy SDK adapter converts older flat param lists into canonical schema with <=2% mismatch rate
Streaming parse hooks emit preliminary validation warnings within first 200ms for >90% of sample streams
Docs and console UI show repair suggestions inline and link to migration guide
decisions: Use a two-stage strategy: fast fuzzy matcher at ingress, strict JSON Schema v7 validation after normalization
Prefer conservative automatic repairs (e.g., coercion from number-to-string) and present opt-in apply fixes in UI
Telemetry will record anonymized mismatch signatures and repair actions; no payload retention
Backcompat adapter will live in runtime edge layer to avoid changes in core serving code
tasks: Implement fuzzy matcher library and publish npm/pypi packages
Author migration scripts to normalize existing tool manifests (scripts/migrate-tool-manifests)
Add console UI components to show repair suggestions and one-click apply
Write E2E tests and fuzzing harness against historical corpus

2025-01-28: Design review notes: PM requests explicit opt-in for automatic repairs due to potential customer surprises (see confluence link).
2025-02-02: Engineering review: identified performance hotspot in naive fuzzy matcher; switched to incremental signature hashing for O(N) matching.
2025-02-10: PR #4128 submitted for streaming-parse hooks. Initial benchmarks: early-warning latency 120ms median, CPU +2% on p3-large.
2025-02-14: UX mockups reviewed by Design. Suggest showing repair confidence and 'why this change' tooltip. Assigned DES-219 for polish.
2025-02-15: Blocker: need a legal review for telemetry signals. Security & Compliance flagged retention constraints. Adding dependency ENG-999512 to track.
notes: This ticket focuses on runtime validation and UX; deeper schema evolution support will be a separate follow-up.
Fuzzing corpus assembled from last 18 months of tool call telemetry (anonymized).
